newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto visits sick general in Jakarta hospital.
newsitem.headline: Suharto visits sick general in Jakarta hospital.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto on Tuesday visited retired general Abdul Haris Nasution in a Jakarta military hospital where he was recuperating from minor surgery, palace sources said.
The sources denied rumours in the foreign exchange market that Suharto had gone to the hospital for treatment.
"The president visited Nasution at the hospital," a palace source said.
"We heard rumours that he (Suharto) went to the hospital because he was sick," one dealer said, adding that the market was waiting for further clarification.
